python_boundary: resident object supplied by Python Macrospace; no subprocess/JSON bridge
macrospace_concurrency: one resident projected provider object per speech lane by default
audio_controller: included provider-neutral SpeechLocalAudioController plus FIFO COTS adapter; no ALSA/PipeWire authority inside Speech
sip_controller: external; current Library SIP/RTP remain separate authorities
cloud_provider: OpenAI Python SDK; model names caller-configured
Azure AI Speech Python SDK; batch TTS/STT plus incremental TTS/STT behind Macrospace

azure_ai_speech.batch_tts: profile-selectable RIFF PCM: default 24kHz; telephony-8k; speech-16k
azure_ai_speech.streaming_tts: profile-selectable raw PCM: default 24kHz; telephony-8k; speech-16k
azure_ai_speech.stream_chunk_backing: short-lived PCM artifact referenced by SpeechAudioChunk
azure_ai_speech.stt: continuous file recognition plus PushAudioInputStream streaming recognition
azure_ai_speech.streaming_stt: raw signed 16-bit mono PCM, 8kHz or 16kHz; partial/final/end events
azure_ai_speech.telephony_profile: telephony-8k = 8000 Hz mono S16LE PCM; aligns with decoded RTP G.711 media boundary

duplex_session: speech.duplex/0.1; concurrent TTS playback, PCM capture-to-STT, and STT event drain; SIP/RTP remain external
